title: Dataset Export Formats
content: The demo evaluation platform supports exporting datasets in CSV, JSONL, and Parquet formats.

title: Benchmark Result Retention
content: Benchmark results are retained for 90 days by default. A workspace owner may delete results sooner.

title: Evaluation Batch Limits
content: A single evaluation batch can contain a maximum of 500 prompts.

title: API Key Security
content: API keys must be stored on the server as environment variables. They must not be embedded in frontend code.

title: Model API Cost Estimation
content: Estimated model API costs are calculated using recorded input and output token usage and configured model pricing. The estimate is not a guaranteed billing total.
